description: Change one expense by id; only the fields you pass move. amount is in MAJOR units. A rebilled expense refuses an amount, currency or vat_rate edit unless unlink_rebill drops the invoice link.

id.description: Expense id from expense_add or expense_list

rebilled.description: false clears the rebilled marker and the invoice number, so the expense can be billed again

unlink_rebill.description: Allow editing amount, currency or vat_rate on a rebilled expense. Clears rebilled_at and rebilled_invoice, because the invoice no longer matches

name: expense_update
title: Update an expense
